title: chiogenes suborbicularis
intro: Chiogenes suborbicularis, commonly known as Sea Sandwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, bronchitis, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve respiratory issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Chiogenes suborbicularis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
